sources.title: Moticont LVCM-070-051-01 product page
sources.method: Read manufacturer page with web tool; followed linked manufacturer drawing.
sources.scope: Direct drive with force approximately proportional to current; external guidance is required. The part page does not establish the installed hot force, our current servo, or full-stroke precision.

sources.title: Moticont LVCM-070-051-01 drawing Rev1
sources.method: Downloaded official PDF, rendered it locally and visually read the single sheet; it has no searchable specification text.

continuousForceCurve.readingPrecision: Approximately, from the plotted force curve; do not infer an exact Kf(position) map.

sources.ratingConditions: The sheet states all values at25°C. No installed hot-rating/cooling boundary is established.
sources.importantDistinction: Rhot8.896Ω in the native plant is an engineering100°C-rise resistance assumption, not a manufacturer measured rating. The catalog204.3N intermittent force would need8.37A at nominalKf, more than our3.5A driver.

sources.title: maxon RE25 302005 product page
sources.method: Read part-specific manufacturer specifications with web tool.
sources.sourceCaution: The product's Catalog page link now opens a2025 replacement-family page containing339xxx parts, not302005. Its replacement specifications were not substituted for the simulated302005 winding. The302005 product is marked NRND.
sources.modelAssumptions: Total modeled rotating inertia adds5e-7kgm² assumed screw/coupler inertia. Native transmission is ideal reversible lead conversion plus explicit friction;90% efficiency is a separate analytical sizing scenario.

sources.title: maxon EC-i30 539489 product page
sources.method: Read manufacturer page; static counterexample only, not a simulated candidate.
sources.analyticalStaticInference: With10mm lead and90% assumed motoring efficiency,0.103Nm supports58.25N before guide loss. This illustrates that a better-sized screw motor may be viable; commutation, backlash/ripple, mounted dynamics and current control remain untested.

sources.title: Sensata LAS28-53-000A-P01 drawing X2
sources.method: Read manufacturer product and linked two-page drawing with web tool.
sources.ratingConditions: Continuous force is at25°C ambient/155°C coil. Winding constants are at midstroke/25°C; peak is limited to10s under stated temperatures.
sources.scope: Efficiency/thermal reference, not recommended as-is: its0.755kg moving assembly already exceeds the entire modeledB=0.6kg budget. Integrated position specifications do not establish our1µm sensor target.

answerScope: Approximate component targets supported by manufacturer data, analytical sizing, existing native histories and fixed-model voltage diagnostics. No purchased actuator, installed cooling, real driver response or new fixed-mechanics leadscrew controller is qualified.
